mechanism: Clotrimazole inhibits CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, both critical for apixaban metabolism and efflux, leading to increased apixaban plasma concentrations.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding closely; consider alternative antifungal agents (e.g., fluconazole with lower CYP3A4 inhibition) or dose adjustment of apixaban if clotrimazole use is necessary.
